result.title: Latent-WAM++: Shaping World and Action Representations for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
result.summary: We introduce Latent-WAM++, a representation-centered World Action Model (WAM) for end-to-end autonomous driving. Existing WAMs are primarily trained to predict future states or final actions, leaving the intermediate world and action representations that connect prediction to planning only indirectly constrained. Latent-WAM++ matches the supervision of each representation to its role in planning. World Representation Construction combines scene-ego future prediction, SIGReg-based distribution stabilization, and frozen geometric priors to learn a temporally predictive, non-degenerate, and geometry-aware world representation without an EMA target encoder. Trajectory MeanFlow Planner directly predicts multimodal trajectory proposals while being optimized with an Improved MeanFlow velocity-space objective, enabling one-step sampling. Visual-Action Representation Alignment further aligns the resulting pre-output action features with a stop-gradient target derived from current visual semantics. Latent-WAM++ achieves state-of-the-art performance on NAVSIM v2 and under zero-shot evaluation on HUGSIM, reaching 90.1 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 and 47.0 average RC and 30.1 average HD-Score on HUGSIM. Training the planner end to end costs 190 GPU-hours for Latent-WAM++ versus 1,600 for Latent-WAM, a reduction of 88.1%.

AI.brief_summary: 提出面向端到端自动驾驶的表示中心世界-动作模型，按规划角色分别监督世界表示与动作表示，并用 MeanFlow 规划器直接生成多模态轨迹、对齐动作特征与当前视觉语义。
AI.relevance_reason: 其世界表示的未来预测、分布稳定化、几何先验及视觉-动作对齐，可能为 LVR 的潜表示保留、防退化与监督设计提供核查线索；但任务属自动驾驶规划而非 VLM 推理，迁移性待核。
